title: Four-class traversability mapping applied across all 8 GOOSE scenarios
dataset: GOOSE 3D validation split, archive downloaded 2026-08-22 from goose-dataset.de
sensor_configuration: Velodyne Alpha Prime 128-channel roof LiDAR only, as distributed in the annotated archive
annotation_schema: GOOSE 64-class semantic labels remapped to a project-authored 4-class traversability taxonomy (Free / Traversable / Potentially Traversable / Non-Traversable), version as committed 2026-08-28
split: validation, the middle frame of each of 8 scenarios
conditions: Summer, autumn, winter, spring; rain and sun; farmland, forest, campus and hills

measurements.name: traversable share, ground slice
measurements.scope: 2022-07-22_flight, lowest return per 0.4 m cell, +/-50 m

measurements.name: non-traversable share, ground slice
measurements.scope: 2023-01-20_aying_mangfall_2, lowest return per 0.4 m cell, +/-50 m

measurements.name: scenarios with a coherent connected drivable route

notes: This applies a hand-authored ground-truth remapping; no model was run, which is why the task type is characterisation rather than traversability-prediction. The paired raw-versus-ground-slice numbers are the substantive finding: a plain bird's-eye projection roughly halves the apparent drivable share and roughly doubles the apparent blocked share, because canopy is painted over the ground beneath it. Any future traversability metric computed from a raw overhead projection will be wrong in the same direction every time, so the projection must be stated alongside the number. The bush class was assigned Non-Traversable by Ricky as a conservative semantic prior; an A/B render showed the choice does not change the Traversable region at all, only the split between uncertain and blocked.
